news.headline: Tenax Therapeutics Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Corporate Update
news.summary: Tenax reported cash and equivalents of $118.0 million as of June 30, 2026, boosted by $13.4 million in Q2 warrant exercise proceeds, extending its runway through Q2 2028; Q2 R&D expense rose to $12.9 million from $6.1 million a year earlier and net loss widened to $17.8 million as Phase 3 LEVEL and LEVEL-2 activities expanded. The company reaffirmed that topline LEVEL data are expected in August 2026, with LEVEL-2 enrollment targeted for completion by the end of 2027.

news.headline: Tenax Therapeutics (NASDAQ:TENX) Research Coverage Started at Canaccord Genuity Group
news.summary: Canaccord Genuity initiated coverage of Tenax with a Buy rating and a $35.00 price target, joining a wave of sell-side initiations ahead of the company's imminent Phase 3 LEVEL data readout. The target implied substantial upside from the stock's mid-to-late-July trading price.

news.headline: Evercore ISI Initiates Tenax Therapeutics Stock Coverage With Outperform Rating
news.summary: Evercore ISI initiated coverage with an Outperform rating and a $39 price target, assigning roughly a 50% probability of success to the Phase 3 LEVEL trial while noting the market price implied only about 20-25% odds, versus roughly 90% downside on trial failure. The note underscored the binary, data-dependent nature of the upcoming readout.

news.headline: Tenax Therapeutics Announces Late-Breaking Presentation of LEVEL Clinical Trial Data at ESC Congress 2026
news.summary: Tenax announced that full results from its registrational Phase 3 LEVEL trial of oral levosimendan (TNX-103) in PH-HFpEF will be presented in a Late-Breaking Clinical Science session at the European Society of Cardiology (ESC) Congress 2026 in Munich, Germany, on August 29, 2026, by Professor Sanjiv Shah of Northwestern University. The abstract was accepted ahead of the company's expected August topline data readout.

news.headline: Tenax Therapeutics Announces Inducement Grants Under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
news.summary: Tenax disclosed inducement stock option grants totaling 160,000 shares awarded on July 1, 2026 to three newly hired non-executive employees in accounting, clinical operations, and CMC/product development roles. The awards were approved by the board's compensation committee as material inducements under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4), vesting over four years.

news.headline: TENX Initiated Coverage by Chardan Capital -- Rating Set as Buy
news.summary: Chardan Capital Markets initiated coverage of Tenax with a Buy rating and a $27.00 price target, implying roughly 125% upside and framing the run-up to the Phase 3 LEVEL data as a defining catalyst for the stock. It was among the first of several sell-side initiations that followed over the subsequent weeks.

catalysts.label: Phase 3 LEVEL topline data readout
catalysts.detail: Tenax expects to report topline data from the registrational Phase 3 LEVEL trial of oral levosimendan (TNX-103) in PH-HFpEF, evaluating 6-minute walk distance in over 230 randomized patients; a December 2025 blinded sample-size re-estimation showed the trial retains over 90% power to detect a 25-meter treatment effect. As of the last update, data had not yet been reported.

catalysts.label: Late-breaking LEVEL data presentation at ESC Congress 2026 (Munich)
catalysts.detail: Full LEVEL trial results will be presented in a Late-Breaking Clinical Science session at the European Society of Cardiology Congress (August 28-31, Munich) by Professor Sanjiv Shah of Northwestern University.

catalysts.label: LEVEL-2 pivotal trial enrollment completion
catalysts.detail: Tenax is enrolling its second global Phase 3 pivotal trial (LEVEL-2) of TNX-103 in PH-HFpEF, activating additional sites with enrollment completion targeted by year-end 2027.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings and corporate update
catalysts.detail: Based on the company's quarterly reporting cadence, Tenax is expected to report third-quarter 2026 financial results and provide a further corporate update, likely including post-LEVEL-readout commentary.

pulse: Tenax Therapeutics is a clinical-stage cardiopulmonary company on the immediate verge of its first major Phase 3 readout: as of this update, topline data from the registrational LEVEL trial of oral levosimendan (TNX-103) in PH-HFpEF are still pending, expected in August 2026, with a late-breaking full-data presentation scheduled for ESC Congress 2026 in Munich on August 29. A cluster of sell-side initiations in June-July (Chardan, Evercore ISI, Canaccord Genuity) set price targets as high as $35-39 on bullish pre-data views, even as Evercore flagged roughly 90% downside risk if the trial fails, reflecting the stock's highly binary risk/reward heading into the catalyst. The company ended Q2 2026 with $118.0 million in cash, giving a runway through Q2 2028 while it simultaneously ramps enrollment in the second pivotal LEVEL-2 trial.
